Name: Auto Jump Over
Author: DarkRobon
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Auto Jump Over[/b][/size]
[size=3]Walk into a farm fence. Hop over it. Keep going.[/size][/center]

Auto Jump Over lets you hop over placed fences on your farm by walking into them. Hold your usual movement key or controller direction toward a fence, and your farmer jumps when there is a clear place to land.

This is an add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1844][b]Jump Over by spacechase0[/b][/url]. You must install Jump Over separately.

[list]
[*]Automatic jumps over placed fences on the main outdoor farm.[/*]
[*]Quick response with a short wait before each jump.[/*]
[*]Works at fence edges and with open gaps between fences.[/*]
[*]Stops in a clear gap when there is less room to land.[/*]
[*]Uses your usual keyboard or controller movement controls.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F8[/b] to turn automatic jumping on or off.[/*]
[*]Jump Over's normal manual jump button remains available between automatic jumps.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] on PC.[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1844][b]Jump Over version 1.3.0[/b][/url] by spacechase0.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and install Jump Over 1.3.0.[/*]
[*]Download Auto Jump Over and open the ZIP.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]AutoJumpOver[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder, beside Jump Over's folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
When updating, close the game and replace Auto Jump Over's files. Keep your [b]config.json[/b] if you want to keep your settings.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size][/color]
Walk toward a fence on your farm and keep pressing toward it for a moment. You will jump if there is enough open space on the other side.

Press [b]F8[/b] to turn auto jump on or off.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size][/color]
Run the game once, then close it and open [b]config.json[/b] inside the AutoJumpOver folder.
[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b]: set to true or false to turn automatic jumping on or off.[/*]
[*][b]PushDelayMilliseconds[/b]: wait before jumping. Default: 50.[/*]
[*][b]LandingCooldownMilliseconds[/b]: wait after landing. Default: 150.[/*]
[*][b]ToggleKey[/b]: shortcut for turning the feature on or off. Default: F8. You can choose a keyboard key or controller button. Use None to remove the shortcut.[/*]
[/list]
Smaller wait numbers make jumping respond sooner.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Automatic jumping is limited to placed fences on the main outdoor farm. Gates are skipped.[/*]
[*]You must be on foot. Automatic jumping stays off while using a tool, eating, sitting, or watching an event.[/*]
[*]It does not add automatic jumping indoors, on the island farm, or over other obstacles. Jump Over's manual controls remain available elsewhere.[/*]
[*]Tested on Windows. macOS and Linux have not been checked.[/*]
[*]Online co-op has not been checked. Automatic jumping is turned off in split-screen.[/*]
[*]Custom farm maps may work but I'm not sure yet[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Questions[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Can I add this to an existing save?[/b]
Yes.

[b]How do I remove it?[/b]
Close the game and remove the AutoJumpOver folder from Mods. You can keep Jump Over installed.

[b]Why did my farmer not jump?[/b]
Check that automatic jumping is on, that you are on foot on the main farm, and that you are walking toward a placed fence. Make sure the landing area is clear and Jump Over 1.3.0 is installed.

[b]How do I report a problem?[/b]
Describe where it happened, how the fences were arranged, and whether you were using a keyboard or controller. Include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] when possible.

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size][/color]
Auto Jump Over is released under the [b]MIT license[/b]. Reuploads, modifications, translations, ports, and reuse are allowed, including commercial use, as long as you keep the copyright and license notice. See [b]LICENSE.txt[/b] in the download for the full terms.

These permissions apply to Auto Jump Over's own files. Jump Over keeps its own authorship and license and must be downloaded separately.
